## v0.1.14

- Show only recently added movies and series in **All content**, sorted by Emby's creation date. Configure the 1–365 day window under **Settings → All content**; the default is 14 days. Existing catalogs without creation dates are refreshed on startup.
- Email requesters when an approved or pending movie or series appears in Emby. Delivery uses the requester's verified OIDC email and the configured SMTP server; failed deliveries can retry on a later sync.
